inManage, a software development company, specializing in sophisticated e-commerce solutions, is looking for a motivated, talented and skillful Junior PHP Developer to join our growing team.Among our customers are huge brands such as McDonald's, Grow (Meshulam), Carrefour, Leaan, Aroma Israel,Machsanei Hashmal, NewDeli and more.

This is a great opportunity to show your talent, work with amazing people, advanced technologies and big customers.

- Knowledge of python - an advantage.
- Experience with Javascript, Reactjs, JQuery, HTML5, XML, CSS, responsive HTML - an advantage
